heroHeadline: Cernavodă Restart Pushed Past September 10 as EU Wildfire Total Hits 647,882 Hectares
heroSubtitle: Romanian officials say the Cernavodă nuclear plant won't restart before 10 September at the earliest as Danube levels remain insufficient, prompting a new three-stage emergency plan (barges, modular dam, pumps) to raise cooling-water flow, while EFFIS puts the EU's cumulative 2026 burned area at 647,882 hectares and warns of extreme fire danger returning across Iberia, France and the Balkans for the coming week.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
